message: 僕には金がないそれでも僕は奢る
Even when I'm told to rest because it's a day off, I just can't seem to settle down.
I mean, sure. I know without Ria-senpai having to tell me that if we collapsed on the day of the event, it would cause a massive amount of trouble for everyone around us.
No, it's precisely because I don't truly get it that I ended up coming here like this, so Ria-senpai really is right after all.

name: Paqy
message: 「That's right. You've still got a long way to go, Demon King.」

name: Synn
message: 「...Did I say that out loud?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Who knows? Still, I'm the Great Sage, after all. Reading the Demon King's mind is a piece of cake for me.」

name: Synn
message: 「Should we grab some tea at Prier before heading back?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Now that's a wise choice. The tea's free, after all.」

name: Synn
message: 「There's tea that isn't free, you know?」

name: Paqy
message: 「For you, Demon King, non-free tea practically doesn't exist, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah」

name: Paqy
message: 「...What are you, a mysterious transfer student?」
In the corner of Prier, Azel was drinking Vandine Jelly.

name: Paqy
message: 「He really doesn't eat anything else, huh.」

name: Synn
message: 「No way...」

name: Synn
message: 「How pitiful that he can only afford to eat something like that! He must not have any money!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Nah, maybe he just can't eat anything else.」

name: Synn
message: 「No, he definitely has no money! Otherwise, he wouldn't be eating nothing but stuff like that!」

name: Paqy
message: 「...Calm down, Synn-sama.」

name: Synn
message: 「I can't calm down! Because that's just too awful!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Easy, easy. Being able to buy that actually makes him richer than you, Synn-sama... Well, it's probably pretty close, though.」
Paqy was saying something, but I ignored him.

name: Synn
message: 「I'm going to treat Azel!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, hey. Are you serious?」

name: Synn
message: 「With what I have right now, I can buy radish sprout ramen!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ah. That thing.」

name: Tennouji-san
message: 「Daikon Sprout Ramen is the cheapest menu item boasted by Ryuusei Academy's cafeteria, 'Prier'.」

name: Tennouji-san
message: 「The firm, chewy noodles and slow-simmered chicken bone broth are exquisite! The toppings consist manfully of just a few daikon sprouts.」

name: Tennouji-san
message: 「Thank you for your kind attention.」

name: Synn
message: 「Even I can afford to treat her to that!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, maybe so, but... no matter how incomprehensible that girl is, isn't Daikon Sprout Ramen a bit much? It's got practically nothing in it, ya know?」

name: Synn
message: 「It has daikon sprouts in it, doesn't it!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well... I suppose treating her to anything else is impossible for you, Synn-sama.」

name: Synn
message: 「I have no money! Still, I'm going to treat her!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Listen, though. If you treat her to that, you'll be flat broke, ya know?」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't care!」

name: Paqy
message: 「You'll have no choice but to sit there drinking plain tea or water while watching her eat ramen, ya know?」
True, that might be a little rough. However.

name: Synn
message: 「Treating someone when you're well off is easy. Treating someone when you're struggling--that's what makes someone worthy of being Student Council President, I think.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku... As expected of Synn-sama. Putting on a display of self-sacrifice like that to grab that weirdo girl's heart--and her body along with it--」

name: Paqy
message: 「Garm!」

name: Synn
message: 「Because this is already decided.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Good grief... Still, shouldn't you tell her you're treating her before buying it?」

name: Synn
message: 「If I did that, she might turn me down, right? Or rather, knowing Azel--」

name: Paqy
message: 「I can practically see her saying 'I don't need it' and walking off.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's why it has to be a surprise attack! It's the only way!」
I gently opened my trusty wallet.
If I pool all my loose change together--not that I have anything besides loose change--I can make it!
Let's do this!
Got the ramen!

name: Synn
message: 「Aah... It smells so good...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Where are the radish sprouts... One, two... Only three?!」

name: Synn
message: 「This is... This is ramen! My entire fortune!」

name: Synn
message: 「This aroma. This warmth. Right now, in my hands, I hold something more precious than the entire world combined!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, ramen... Oh, ramen...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Listen here. Master Synn」

name: Synn
message: 「...Gah, wh-what is it」

name: Paqy
message: 「If you're gonna swoon over it that much, why don't you just scarf it down yourself?」

name: Synn
message: 「Wh-what are you saying!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Think about it. Do you really think that woman's gonna accept the ramen you offer her? She's just gonna spout 'I don't want it' or something anyway」
That's possible.

name: Paqy
message: 「And when that happens, you're gonna end up eating it yourself anyway, right? Or are you gonna throw it out?」

name: Synn
message: 「P-Paqy! What a horrifying thing to say!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Then. Even if Master Synn eats it right here and now, you're just skipping a step, so it doesn't make much difference, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「I won't give up just from getting turned down once. I'll beg her over and over until she eats it!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Why are you getting so fired up over this?」

name: Synn
message: 「There are times when a man has to do what a man has to do」

name: Paqy
message: 「Even if all you've got for yourself is water?」
The hot tea dispenser was out of order.

name: Synn
message: 「...Even if all I have for myself is water」

name: Paqy
message: 「I get Master Synn's resolve loud and clear. I ain't gonna stop you anymore. Go ahead and see it through as far as you can」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't need you to tell me that!」
I turned my gaze toward the spot where Azel had been sitting--

name: Paqy
message: 「She's gone」

name: Paqy
message: 「If she ain't here, nothing we can do about it. Let's devour that thing ourselves before the noodles get soggy」
Without a word, I walked over to the table where Azel had been sitting and gently set down the ramen and Paqy.

name: Paqy
message: 「Even if it's just radish sprouts, it looks pretty good... Wait, what're you doing, Lord Synn?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Stroking a chair to savor the warmth left behind by the ass of the girl who was sitting in it―what a pervert―」

name: Paqy
message: 「Shapan!」
It's still faintly warm. Not much time could have passed since she left her seat.

name: Synn
message: 「I'm going to look for her! Paqy, keep watch so nothing happens to my ramen until Azel and I get back!」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel!」

name: Synn
message: 「Miss Azel!」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel-chan!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel~! Azel~!」

name: Synn
message: 「Um... Azel... -tan?」
Sigh...
Still, I mustn't lose heart!
I still have my ramen!

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh, Mr. President. Thank you for the meal.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It would have been a waste if the noodles got soggy, so I went ahead and ate it.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Man, that hit the spot.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It was delicious. Is this what they commonly call plain ramen?」

name: Paqy
message: 「It had radish sprouts in it, radish sprouts!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I didn't notice... I'm shocked.」
I peered into the bowl with 0.1 percent hope.

name: Lolotte
message: 「You really mustn't do that, Mr. President. If you don't eat ramen right away, the noodles get soggy.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It was almost past the point of being edible. Close call, close call. That was a narrow escape.」

name: Paqy
message: 「I was keepin' a proper eye on it, ya know. Thing is, she had a point about it goin' to waste if it got soggy.」
It was empty. Not a single strand of noodle, not a single sprout, not even a single drop of broth remained.

name: Paqy
message: 「Figured preventin' a tragic waste took priority over just standin' guard, so I helped myself to a share.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「With this, one's energy for tomorrow really comes surging forth」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well said, man」
On that day, I.
May have come to know true nothingness and despair for the very first time.
